text:
Maria (AM): Heads-up — we’re flipping the pricing matrix to v4 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Main user-facing changes: deprecate the old Starter committed SKU, introduce a Sustained commit band, and move discounting to % bands instead of flat tiers. Please read before EOD. :eyes:
Devon (Sales Ops): Quick q — what happens to active POCs that cited Starter commits? Any automatic fallthrough?
Sujay (Pricing): Good Q. Short answer: POCs keep current pricing for the length of the POC, then new renewal quotes should use Sustained. We’re providing a grandfathering exception window for renewals signed within 30 days of the rollout. If the renewal is >30d, you quote v4.
Pat (RevOps): Can you spell out the approval path for exceptions? Deal desk SLA?
Sujay (Pricing): Exceptions: tag deal as `pricing:grandfather` and include a 1–2 line rationale + ARR delta. Deal Desk has a 48h SLA for these. If ARR > $250k or term >24 months, escalate to Head of RevOps for approval.
Devon (Sales Ops): Update needed for CPQ templates — which fields change? I’ll push a patch but want exact field names.
Sujay (Pricing): CPQ changes: replace `starter_commit_qty` with `sustained_commit_band`, remove `flat_discount_points`, add `discount_pct_band`. Also add a free-text `grandfather_note` field for exceptions. Example command we tested:
```
cpq update-template --sku sustained_commit --add-field discount_pct_band
cpq set-field-mapping starter_commit_qty:sustained_commit_band
```
Pat (RevOps): Noted. I’ll queue a release to sandbox tonight and run regression on quoting automation.
Olivia (Legal): We also need a short contract amendment paragraph for existing MSA customers who opt into grandfathering. Drafting now — will post a snippet here for sign-off.
Maria (AM): Thanks. Also CI for pricing docs: please update the internal pricing page and the public FAQ. Deal teams need a 1-pager for AE enablement. Can someone own the one-pager?
Devon (Sales Ops): I’ll own the 1-pager and AE slide deck. Will sync with Sujay on language.
Sujay (Pricing): FYI, promo codes are being consolidated. Any open promotional commitments tied to Starter must be listed in the exception spreadsheet or they get converted to a one-time credit at the time of renewal.
Devon (Sales Ops): Where’s the exception spreadsheet?
DealBot: Automated message: pricing-v4-exceptions.xlsx uploaded to Google Drive https://company-drive/restricted/pricing-v4-exceptions.xlsx — notify Deal Desk if you add a row. :file_folder:
Pat (RevOps): A couple of implementation notes: 1) Billing engine needs a small migration for the commit metric naming; 2) Analytics delta will show a spike in `onetime_credit` events for the first 60 days.
Sujay (Pricing): Correct. Also, for quoting, use `discount_pct_band` values: 0-5, 6-15, 16-30. We’ll publish mapping guidance in the doc.
Olivia (Legal): Draft contract clause posted: "Customer retains existing committed pricing for active POC and renewals executed within 30 days of Redwood Pricing Matrix v4 rollout. All other renewals shall follow v4 pricing. Exceptions require Deal Desk written approval." Feedback welcome.
Devon (Sales Ops): One small ask — can Deal Desk please triage the higher-ARR exceptions first? We’ve got a couple of strategic deals in the funnel.
Sujay (Pricing): Affirmative. We’ll tag ARR>250k with `priority` in the spreadsheet.
Maria (AM): Okay team — action items: Devon — 1-pager + CPQ owner; Pat — sandbox release + billing migration smoke; Sujay — publish exception guidance + CPQ mappings; Olivia — finalize clause; Deal Desk — ok the 48h SLA and prioritize >250k. I’ll send calendar invites for a 30-min rollout sync at 08:00 PT tomorrow. :calendar:
Devon (Sales Ops): Got it, will drop meeting invite and draft the 1-pager by EOD. :thumbsup:
Sujay (Pricing): I’ll be on the 08:00 sync.
Olivia (Legal): Will post final clause before midnight.
DealBot: Automated message: pricing-matrix-v4 docs published https://internal-docs/pricing/v4 — changelog attached.
Maria (AM): Thanks everyone. If you hit blockers, ping me directly.
Devon (Sales Ops): Pinged a couple of AEs to flag renewal conversations this week.
Pat (RevOps): Starting sandbox deploy in 15m — will post logs here if anything fails.
Sujay (Pricing): :rocket:
